title: List files
description: List files matching a glob pattern like "src/**/*.js", "*.md" or "**/package.json". By default this lists the bound workspace. To list a read-only reference repository, pass dir: "reference:<repo>" or a subdirectory such as "reference:opencode/packages/opencode/src". Returned paths are ready to hand to read_file. Build output, node_modules and .git are skipped.

pattern.description: Glob: "*" matches within one path segment, "**" matches across segments, "?" one character. E.g. "src/**/*.ts", "*.json", "**/README.md".

dir.description: Optional workspace subdirectory ("src") or read-only reference root/subdirectory ("reference:opencode" or "reference:opencode/packages/app"). Defaults to the workspace root.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset for the next page. When truncated is true, repeat the call with nextOffset instead of repeating the same arguments.

includeDirs.description: Match directories as well as files (default false).

examples: list every markdown file at the top level
